labels.name: Your name
labels.project_type: What type of project do you have?

why.title: More than effective editing. Here is what I bring to your project

items.title: No low-quality AI-generated content
items.body: I do not use generative AI unless you explicitly request it. No AI upscaling, synthetic voices or AI-generated images. All materials come from publicly available sources and are cleared for use without platform claims.

items.title: Asynchronous communication
items.body: I work with creators across time zones in Russian and English. We communicate asynchronously, ensuring your project is delivered on time.

items.title: Long-term collaboration
items.body: I can move straight from one completed project to the next and remain consistently available over the long term. Most client engagements have ended before my capacity to continue supporting them did.

items.title: Automated routine tasks
items.body: I automate routine tasks, such as organising source footage, with custom plugins. This frees up more time for editing and reduces time spent on repetitive work.

steps.title: Project agreement
steps.body: We discuss the brief, the volume of source footage, references and deadlines. I accept urgent projects at a higher rate.

steps.title: Editing
steps.body: Once I receive the footage, I begin editing. I send drafts for your review and approval, incorporating your feedback. You see progress throughout the process.

steps.title: Final delivery
steps.body: I deliver the final version via your preferred storage service. A 10-minute video with motion graphics typically takes one full week to complete.

items.q: How much do your services cost?
items.a: The final price depends on the references, the volume of source footage and the delivery deadline. Long-form videos start at $200. We agree on the exact price during our discussion.
A 10-minute video with a moderate amount of motion graphics is completed within a week. We agree on deadlines in advance, and I guarantee that I will meet them.

items.q: How should I send you the footage?
items.a: Use whichever method suits you: Google Drive, Dropbox, Nextcloud, your own FTP server or another file-sharing service. The only requirement is that the service supports high-speed downloads.

items.q: How many revisions are included in the price?
items.a: I include two rounds of revisions in the project budget as standard. Any further rounds are agreed separately, as these usually involve a change in the project concept rather than refinements to the existing edit.

items.q: Do you work with international clients?
items.a: Yes. I work with clients in CIS and Western markets in Russian and English, delivering the highest quality for clients anywhere in the world.

items.q: Do you use AI in your work?
items.a: Only if you explicitly request it. Otherwise, I do not use AI-generated voices, graphics or inserts. Everything is created or sourced manually, without generative AI.

hero.title: Complete video editing and motion graphics: from raw footage to final delivery
hero.sub: I handle the entire editing process: assembly, colour correction, graphics and sound design. You provide the footage and receive a finished video.
